versions.content: Ethernet port shaper idleSlope The idleSlope is defined in the IEEE802.1Qav standard as a parameter for an increase of credit in bits per second. The idleSlope can never exceed the maximal transmit rate of a port, e.g. 100MBits for BroadR-Reach and 1GBits for RTPGE. The idleSlope determines the maximum fraction of the port transmit rate that is available for the queue associated with the shaper: bandwidthFraction = idleSlope/portTransmitRate.
